preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The length of each string P must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#.' for c in P)
preconditions.description: Each string P must consist only of the characters '#' and '.'.
The first and last characters of each string P must be '#', representing floorboards.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of days it takes to cross the passage for each test case.
